text_truncation: none: reasoning and quote are full text in this feed

schema.id: Stable sha256 content hash of the insight. Primary key, safe to dedupe on.
schema.published_at: ISO 8601 UTC publication timestamp of the SOURCE episode. Null when the source date could not be determined. Never an ingest timestamp.
schema.manager_name: Display name of the fund manager or firm the speaker represents. Null when the speaker's firm is unknown. Media platforms are never managers.
schema.manager_slug: Canonical manager identifier. Join key for by-manager shards and managers.json.
schema.manager_alias: Alternate name the manager appeared under in the source, if any.
schema.speaker_name: Name of the person who made the statement.
schema.speaker_type: Role of the speaker: portfolio_manager, analyst, commentator, host, guest, other.
schema.show_homepage: Homepage URL of the podcast show.
schema.kind: Insight category, e.g. stock_view, macro_view, sector_view, portfolio_action.
schema.asx_code: Resolved ASX ticker, uppercase. Null for macro or unresolved mentions.
schema.ticker_raw: Ticker exactly as spoken or written in the source.
schema.company_name_raw: Company name as it appeared in the source.
schema.sector: GICS sector of the company, when resolved.
schema.region: Region the view applies to, e.g. AU, US, GLOBAL.
schema.stance: Directional stance: bullish, bearish, neutral, discuss.
schema.conviction: Conviction level when stated: high, medium, low. Often null.
schema.headline: One-line summary of the view. Full text, not truncated.
schema.reasoning: Supporting rationale. Full text, not truncated.
schema.quote: Verbatim quote from the speaker. Full text, not truncated.
schema.text_truncated: Legacy flag from the old slim-sourced feed. Absent or false now that the feed carries full text.
schema.manager_holds_asx: True if the manager had a disclosed holding in asx_code at the nearest disclosure date.
schema.manager_holding_weight_pct: Portfolio weight percent of that disclosed holding.
schema.manager_holding_as_of: As-of date of the disclosure used for manager_holds_asx.
schema.is_institutional: True when the speaker's firm is an institutional investor rather than a retail commentator.
schema.episode_url: Direct URL to the source audio.
